166.name: Holy Vanguard
166.desc: <color=#6fc075>Recovers</color> Health every second. Health recovered is increased if his Movement Speed has been reduced.

166.name: Valiant Charge
166.desc: Gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> and enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the enemy in front, then <color=#50c1eb>damage</color> and <color=#fa863a>silence</color> them.

166.name: Whirling Strike
166.desc: Deals <color=#fa863a>damage</color> every second to enemies within range.

166.name: Might of Excalibur
166.desc: Leaps to the target, <color=#db70d0>damaging</color> and <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> them.

112.name: Suppressive Fire
112.desc: After using 4 Basic Attacks or a skill, the next Basic Attack becomes a scattershot, dealing continuous piercing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

112.name: Blowfish Grenade
112.desc: Throws a bomb at the target location, dealing area <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.

112.name: Shark Cannon
112.desc: Launches a rocket in the target direction, <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies directly in front of him and dealing area <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

112.name: Air Support
112.desc: Summons a blowfish airship to bombard the target location, dealing area <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies while gaining <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of the area.

105.name: Warrior's Soul
105.desc:
Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> when using skills.
During combat, generates Battle Spirit, which increases <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>. When out of combat, Battle Spirit is consumed to <color=#6bc872>recover</color> health.

105.name: Burst Ram
105.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> enemies in his path. When upgraded, gains a passive effect that <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> every 3rd Basic Attack.

105.name: Magma Slam
105.desc: Charges up at the original location, gaining a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> nearby enemies while pulling non-hero enemy units toward the center. After a brief delay, deals <color=#ff6600>area damage</color>. If there are enemy units within range, Skill 1's cooldown is <color=#ffc834>reset</color>.

105.name: Tremor Smash
105.desc: <color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> to the target location and hammers the ground 3 times. The first 2 strikes deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color> enemies, while the 3rd strike deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> them.

106.name: Encouraging Thoughts
106.desc: Hitting enemies with skills <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> herself, <color=#6bc872>increasing her Movement Speed</color>.

106.name: Blossoming Fan
106.desc: Throws fan in the target direction, which returns to her upon reaching max range, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies in its path both ways.

106.name: Honeysweet Breeze
106.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in the target area and <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> them.

106.name: Meteor Storm
106.desc: Summons meteors, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies in range.

522.name: Gift of the Stars
522.desc: <color=#6bc872>Recovers</color> Health when landing skill hits. Using any 3 skills <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> his next skill, and using the <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> skill will <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> his next Basic Attack.

522.name: Star Rush
522.desc: <color=#6bc872>Moves quickly</color>, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies in his path.

522.name: Return to Dust
522.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Returns</color> to his location 2s ago, removes Star Reduction, and deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in his path.
Passive: Some of his damage taken is converted into <color=#ffc834>Star Reduction</color> after a short delay.

153.name: Secret Skill - Rush
153.desc: When an enemy is within a certain range, moving toward them will grant him increased <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

153.name: Secret Skill - Split
153.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within a certain range, and deals a second strike of <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to a random enemy in range.

153.name: Secret Skill - Sling
153.desc: Throws a dagger that <color=#ff6600>damages</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color>, and <color=#ffc834>marks</color> the first enemy in its path. When attacking marked targets, he <color=#2bc6ff>stuns</color> them and <color=#6bc872>recovers Health</color>. Marks deal grievous <color=#ff6600>damage</color> when disappearing.

153.name: Secret Skill - Strike
153.desc: <color=#ffc834>Exits stealth</color> mode and <color=#6bc872>dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path.

153.name: Secret Skill - Shadow
153.desc: Enters <color=#ffc834>stealth</color> after a short delay, increasing <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Leaving stealth increases <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>. Stealth ends if near an enemy hero for too long.

118.name: Hourglass of Time
118.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> bonus after using skills.

118.name: Time Bomb
118.desc: Fires a bomb in the target direction, which deals damage and attaches itself to the hit enemy. After a brief delay, inflicts area <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

118.name: Time Flux
118.desc:
Increases his and nearby teammates' <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. When the effect ends, he <color=#ffc834>restores</color> <color=#6bc872>Health</color> equal to 25% of the damage taken during the effect's duration.
<color=#ffc834>Passive</color>: Gains Cooldown Reduction.

118.name: Time Lapse
118.desc: Throws a bomb in the target direction, inflicting area <color=#f264ff>damage</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>, and <color=#2bc6ff>silence</color> upon coming in contact with an enemy or reaching its max range. After a brief delay, the bomb deals area <color=#f264ff>damage</color> again.

107.name: Dragon's Roar
107.desc: As his Health declines, he gains more <color=#6fc075>damage reduction</color> and his basic skills are enhanced.

107.name: Thunderbreaker
107.desc: Charges forward, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Stocks an extra use of Thunderbreaker each time there is a change in his Passive slots.

107.name: Stormpiercer
107.desc: Jabs repeatedly in the target direction, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color>. <color=#6fc075>Recovers</color> Health on hit.

107.name: Skysplitter
107.desc:
Leaps to the target area to deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> enemies in the center.
50% of the cooldown is returned if no heroes are hit.

125.name: Occult Arts - Manipulation
125.desc: Gain Hero Shards and recover Health when attacking. Collect 50 Hero Shards to summon the corresponding hero.

125.name: Occult Arts - Umbra
125.desc: Throws the <color=#ffce49>puppet</color>, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> enemies in the path, then begins controlling the <color=#ffce49>puppet</color>.

125.name: Occult Arts - Zhi Chu Luan
125.desc: Tosses paper birds, which deal <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemies in their path.

125.name: Occult Arts - Shadow Crucifixion
125.desc: Releases several strings, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to targets hit. Repeated hits additionally inflict <color=#50c1eb>slow</color>.

125.name: Occult Arts - Dispersal
125.desc: Vanishes, <color=#ffce49>cleansing</color> all crowd control effects, then <color=#6fc075>reappears</color> in the target location after a brief delay.

108.name: Fight for Peace
108.desc:
Every 4th Basic Attack deals <color=#6bc872>area damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocks back</color> enemies.
Gains <color=#6bc872>shield</color> stacks when using skills, for up to 3 stacks.

108.name: Peacebringer
108.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in his path.
The next Basic Attack is <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>, becoming Fight for Peace.

108.name: Cannon Blast
108.desc: Fires a shell in the target direction, <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> and dealing area <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to the 1st enemy hit. The shell leaves a crater in the ground after reaching its max range or hitting an enemy, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time to enemies that step in it.

108.name: Think Inside the Box
108.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time to enemies within a certain range of himself, <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> enemies every time he deals damage.

124.name: Blaze
124.desc: <color=#f264ff>Damage</color> from Basic Attacks and skills apply <color=#2dc6ff>marks</color> to enemy units and structures. At 4 stacks, targets are <color=#2bc6ff>slowed</color> and suffer <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time.

124.name: Wildfire
124.desc:
Invokes a wind domain in the target direction, <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies in range.
Nearby teammates gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>, and his nearby fires will spread in the direction of the wind.

124.name: Scorching Bolt
124.desc:
Creates a fire domain at the target location that deals burning <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within it.
Up to 6 fire domains can exist at a time.
<color=#6bc872>Recovers Health</color> over time while in a fire domain.
Can stock up to 3 charges of this skill.

124.name: Flames of War
124.desc:
Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in range.
If there's a fire domain in range, any enemies within it will be <color=#2bc6ff>stunned</color> and take extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

111.name: Energy Burst
111.desc: Basic Attacks reduce the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skill 1.

111.name: Rolling Raid
111.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Rolls</color> in the target direction, gaining an enhanced Basic Attack that has <color=#6bc872>extra range</color> and <color=#6bc872>pierces</color> through enemies.
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> if there are enemy heroes nearby after rolling.

111.name: Frag Grenade
111.desc: Throws a grenade at the target location, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and marking enemies hit, <color=#2bc6ff>reducing</color> their Physical Defense by 10%. Her Basic Attack deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to marked targets.

111.name: Ultimate Shell
111.desc: Fires a shot in the target direction, dealing area <color=#ff6600>damage</color> when enemies are hit or when exploding at max range.

114.name: Magnetic Barrier
114.desc: Skills deal equal damage to structures and <color=#ffc834>disrupt</color> them, while also <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health.

114.name: Overcharge!
114.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> and increased <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> while <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> the next Basic Attack to <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>launch</color> enemies.

114.name: Robo Smash
114.desc: Inflicts <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>stun</color> on enemies in the target area.

114.name: Take It for a Spin
114.desc: Unleashes a spinning attack that continuously deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to nearby enemies. While spinning, Basic Attacks <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color> and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to targets.

109.name: Captivate
109.desc: Skill hits <color=#2dc6ff>reduce</color> the enemy's Magical Defense (up to 3 stacks).

109.name: Soul Impact
109.desc: Unleashes a shockwave in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

109.name: Strike a Pose
109.desc: Casts a love spell at the target, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> them.

109.name: Heartbreaker
109.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to random enemies within range 5 times.

113.name: Nature's Will
113.desc: Periodically <color=#ffc834>removes crowd control effects</color> and increases <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color>.

113.name: Kaleidoscope
113.desc: Triggers Nature's Will, releasing dream butterflies in a cone-shaped area, inflicting <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies in range.

113.name: Sleep Starts
113.desc:
<color=#f264ff>Damages</color> enemies within range and increases teammates' <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.
Gains a stack each time damage is dealt, up to 5 stacks. Each stack increases skill damage.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> Periodically uses Sleep Starts.

113.name: Butterfly Effect
113.desc: <color=#ffc834>Removes crowd control effects</color> from teammates within range and provides a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

115.name: Guitar Solo
115.desc: For every 3 Basic Attacks or skills Gao uses, his Basic Attack is <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> on hit.

115.name: Wild Chord
115.desc: Launches musical notes that bounce between enemies, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

115.name: String Bender
115.desc: <color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> enemies within range. Hits on heroes <color=#6bc872>recover</color> Health, and he gains <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> during the dash.

115.name: Rock Out!
115.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> while dealing continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range.

581.name: Flow of the World
581.desc:
Can change Flow states at the Base to enhance stats.
Vitality: Increases <color=#6bc872>max Health</color> and <color=#6bc872>Physical and Magical Defense</color>.
Piercing Heart: Increases <color=#6bc872>max Health</color> and <color=#ff6600>Physical Attack</color>.
Haste: Increases <color=#6bc872>max Health</color> and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.
Focus: Increases <color=#6bc872>max Health</color> and <color=#6bc872>Cooldown Reduction</color>.
Spend 1 stack of Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and gain <color=#6bc872>recovery</color>.

581.name: Convergence
581.desc:
Channels the Flow, <color=#6bc872>reducing the cooldown of other skills by 50%</color>. Also gains 5–9 stacks of Flow based on the number of nearby heroes and minions and <color=#6bc872>recovers Health</color> based on Flow stacks.
<color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#ff6600>knocks back</color> nearby enemies (without applying crowd control).

581.name: Power From Within
581.desc:
Charges at the target and slashes, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> enemies, and gaining a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.
Using the skill continuously over a short time converts it to Clearing Slash and Rifting Slash.
<color=#ffc834>If the skill is not on cooldown, spend 4 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after use.</color>

581.name: All In
581.desc:
Leaps to the target location and attacks, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> enemies.
<color=#ffc834>If the skill is not on cooldown, spend 5 stacks of Flow to stop it from entering cooldown after this use.</color>

110.name: Keen Feathers
110.desc: Basic Attacks can pierce and deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in their path.

110.name: Arrows of Gold
110.desc: Conjures an arrow formation that deals continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to targets within range while <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them.

110.name: Golden Winged Blessing
110.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> while dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.

110.name: Wings of Judgment
110.desc: Sends arrows surging forward, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. Using the skill again shoots all remaining arrows, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> nearby enemies, inflicting them with Dread, and removing all Physical Attack bonuses granted by their equipment.

116.name: Kiss of Death
116.desc: Attacks launched from the front of the target will not crit, but <color=#ffc834>backstabs</color> are guaranteed to crit.

116.name: Arclight
116.desc: Attacks twice in a row, dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color>.

116.name: Untouchable
116.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward and attacks, marking an enemy while dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and gaining Attack Speed. Attacking marked targets <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> them and reduces this skill's cooldown. She takes less damage from marked targets.

116.name: Phantom Dance
116.desc: Enters <color=#ffc834>stealth</color>, gaining a Movement Speed boost and <color=#6bc872>Health recovery</color>. She enhances her attacks after exiting stealth, gains extra Movement Speed upon dealing damage, and refreshes all skill <color=#6bc872>cooldowns</color> with defeats and assists.

117.name: Petrifying Strike
117.desc:
Skills and Basic Attacks have a chance to <color=#2bc6ff>petrify</color> enemy heroes.
<color=#ffc834>Passive</color>: Periodically gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

117.name: Storm and Stress
117.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> to the target location and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack to inflict extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

117.name: Hurricane Hammer
117.desc:
Spins her hammer for a period of time, continuously dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to nearby enemies.
While the skill is active, gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> boost and <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

119.name: Malicious Practice
119.desc: Skills place poison <color=#50c1eb>marks</color> on enemies, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage over time</color>, and place healing marks on teammates, continuously <color=#6fc075>healing</color> them. He can also <color=#ffce49>resurrect</color> defeated teammates.

119.name: Deadly Panacea
119.desc: Tosses a vial of poison that deals <color=#db70d0>damage</color> over time and <color=#50c1eb>slows</color> enemies in range.

119.name: Forbidden Formula
119.desc: Unleashes a poison orb, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> enemies. The orb is <color=#ffce49>enhanced</color> when it passes through poison.

119.name: Master of Life
119.desc: <color=#db70d0>Damages</color> enemies and <color=#6fc075>heals</color> teammates in range. Each stack of mark increases damage and healing.

120.name: Reaper's Revenge
120.desc: Gains Energy when dealing or taking damage, increasing his <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> his recovery effects.

120.name: Blood Echo
120.desc:
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to nearby enemies and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health. Charging up will boost the skill's effects.
Passive: When taking damage, there is a chance to automatically trigger Skill 1.

120.name: Deathscythe
120.desc: Summons scythes in the target direction, <color=#2dc6ff>pulling back</color> enemies within range while inflicting <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color>.

120.name: Lay Waste
120.desc:
Leaps to the target location and <color=#2dc6ff>taunts</color> enemies while dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> his recovery effects.
<color=#2dc6ff>Taunt</color> duration increases with max Health.

150.name: Killing Spear
150.desc: Every 4th Basic Attack <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> the target. Hits from skills and enhanced Basic Attacks grant <color=#6bc872>increased</color> Attack Speed.

150.name: Ruthless Assault
150.desc: <color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> to the target location to deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launch</color> the enemy. The second charge will not launch the enemy.

150.name: Fight or Die!
150.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> backward and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack to deal extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
<color=#4f6f95>If the Fight or Die! sweep is his 4th Basic Attack, it will include the 4th Basic Attack's extra effects.</color>

150.name: The Unrivaled Spear
150.desc: Swings spear 4 times, gaining <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> and <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color>. Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> each time and <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies the 4th time.

121.name: Eternal Youth
121.desc: <color=#ffc834>Summons</color> a shadow servant that <color=#f264ff>damages</color> enemies and <color=#6bc872>restores</color> Health to her whenever she uses a skill. She also gains Shadow Power that boosts her <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>healing effects</color>.

121.name: Dark Transfer
121.desc: Unleashes shadow energy, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies that come into contact with it. Can use the skill again to <color=#6bc872>teleport</color> to the shadow's location, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> again. Summons a shadow servant when either use of the skill hits an enemy.

121.name: Ravenous Tether
121.desc:
Releases a tether that links to the first enemy hit.
<color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> over time. <color=#ffc834>Steals</color> Physical and Magical Attack while <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health.

121.name: Umbral Moon
121.desc: Removes debuffs, gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>, and becomes <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color>. Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies upon entering and exiting the untargetable state.

169.name: Chastising Shot
169.desc: Each Basic Attack hit increases <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>. When the effect is fully stacked, he shoots <color=#6bc872>several shots</color> with each Basic Attack.

169.name: Arrow Volley
169.desc: Increases Basic Attack damage and shoots <color=#6bc872>extra arrows</color> to hit multiple enemies.

169.name: Burning Sun Arrow
169.desc: Shoots a long-range explosive arrow that <color=#2dc6ff>stuns</color> the target on hit, dealing <color=#ff6600>area damage</color> and inflicting <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color>.

123.name: Bloodthirsty Ancestry
123.desc: Enchants his weapon when it hits an enemy during Skill 1 or Ultimate. While enchanted, Basic Attacks and Skills deal additional <color=#ffffff>true damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>recover</color> his Health.

123.name: Impaling Thrust
123.desc: Performs a sweep attack on the target area. <color=#6bc872>Restores a certain amount of Health</color> with each enemy hero hit. Failing to hit a hero will cause his enhancement to disappear.

123.name: Souleater
123.desc: <color=#2bc6ff>Slows</color> and <color=#ff6600>damages</color> enemies in the target area and gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> for each enemy hit (up to 3 stacks). The shield value is converted to <color=#6bc872>Health</color> over time.

123.name: Tremble, Mortals
123.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> to the target location, <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> and <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> enemies within range upon landing, then forming a ring of slaughter.
While inside the ring, he gains increased Physical and Magical Defense, while enemies suffer damage and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

126.name: Unyielding Might
126.desc: Periodic Passive effect: When Health drops beyond a certain threshold, taking damage will <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> him. While enhanced, he <color=#6bc872>recovers Health</color> when hitting enemies with skills and Basic Attacks.

126.name: Wind Slash
126.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Slashes</color> in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them.
If the skill lands a hit, it can be used again before going into cooldown, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in range and <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> them.

126.name: Gale's Benediction
126.desc:
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in range and grants a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.
<color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> the next 3 Basic Attacks to deal extra <color=#ffffff>true damage</color>.
Every enhanced Basic Attack hit reduces his Ultimate's <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color>.

126.name: Unruly Blade
126.desc:
Throws his chain blade to the target location, <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color> and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies hit.
When max range is reached or an enemy is hit, the chain blade will <color=#6bc872>pull</color> him to its location, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to nearby enemies.

127.name: Frozen Touch
127.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy with skills 3 times within a short period of time will deal extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>freeze</color> them.

127.name: Ocean of Tears
127.desc: Conjures <color=#ffc834>icicles</color> that block heroes, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> enemies within range. If Lady Zhen is near the icicles when conjured, she becomes frozen and <color=#ffc834>invincible</color>. The icicles shatter when the skill ends or is canceled, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> (<color=#f264ff>damage</color> is doubled at the center).

127.name: Flowing Sigh
127.desc: Unleashes a water orb that deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

127.name: Destructive Deluge
127.desc: Unleashes a water spirit that forms a pool. The pool deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> them.

128.name: Only the Strong
128.desc:
Whenever he uses a skill, gains an enhanced Basic Attack that unleashes sword energy. Enhanced Basic Attacks have higher <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>restore</color> Health.
<color=#4f6f95>While using Sacred Tree Blessing, enhanced Basic Attacks unleash 1 additional blast of sword energy</color>.

128.name: The King's Blade
128.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward to deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. The 3rd skill use also <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> the enemy.

128.name: The King's Return
128.desc:
Unleashes sword energy, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them. <color=#6bc872>Recovers</color> Health if he hits a hero.
<color=#4f6f95>While using Sacred Tree Blessing, he unleashes 1 additional blast of sword energy</color>.

128.name: Sacred Tree Blessing
128.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Cleanses himself of all crowd control effects</color>, deals <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> to nearby enemies, and gains <color=#6bc872>max Health</color>.
While this skill is active, Skill 2 and enhanced Basic Attacks unleash sword energy. He also continuously gains enhanced Basic Attacks.
<color=#4f6f95>Tap again to end the skill</color>.

129.name: Mounting Rage
129.desc: All skills can <color=#ffc834>cleanse crowd controls</color>. Each successful cleanse boosts his <color=#6bc872>Physical Attack</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Range</color>, for up to 6 stacks.

129.name: Holding On to Sanity
129.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> bonus and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack to deal extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

129.name: Outburst
129.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> them. His Attack Speed and Lifesteal are <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> when striking an enemy. If he misses, he gains only half of the Attack Speed, Lifesteal, and extra Health recovery effects.

129.name: Leap of Fury
129.desc: <color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> toward the target enemy, dealing <color=#ffffff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them. <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> himself, dealing <color=#ffffff>extra damage</color> to enemies while enhanced.

130.name: Niten Ichiryuu
130.desc:
Using skills generates Vigor, which is consumed by Basic Attacks to gain <color=#6bc872>enhancement</color> effects. Hitting an enemy reduces the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skills 1 and 2.
1 Vigor: <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> Basic Attack damage.
2 Vigor: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> enemies.

130.name: Illuminating Slash
130.desc:
Unleashes sword energy in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in its path and <color=#ffc834>knocking down</color> projectiles.
Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> when using the skill.

130.name: Extreme Speed
130.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and gaining a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> upon hitting an enemy.

130.name: Duel to the Death
130.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> to the target, <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> and <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> enemies within range. Also <color=#ffc834>delays</color> the target's recovery effects.

131.name: Way of the Sword
131.desc: Basic Attack hits grant <color=#6bc872>stacks</color>. At 4 stacks, <color=#6bc872>increases</color> Physical Attack and <color=#ffc834>unlocks</color> the Ultimate.

131.name: Stupor Slash
131.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> and leaves an afterimage at the start point while <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color> and <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> enemies in his path.
Can <color=#6bc872>dash</color> again before cooldown starts, and a third time to return to the afterimage.

131.name: Stroke of Genius
131.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Removes all debuffs</color> from self and becomes <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color>.
<color=#ff6600>Damages</color> enemies in range, leaving behind a sword formation.
Enemies that touch the edge of the formation are <color=#ff6600>damaged</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slowed</color>, and <color=#2bc6ff>sundered</color>.

131.name: Flickering Flurry
131.desc:
Transforms into a phantom, continuously slashing at the specified area.
<color=#ffc834>Removes all debuffs</color> and becomes <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color> while the skill is active.
Deals <color=#ff6600>area damage</color>, but damage is diminished upon hitting multiple enemy heroes.

170.name: Reinforced Shells
170.desc: When Basic Attacks hit a hero, it <color=#6bc872>increases</color> his Physical Pierce.

170.name: Dual Shot
170.desc: Increases <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack to <color=#ff6600>damage twice</color>.

170.name: Leading the Charge
170.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies in the way.

170.name: Hearts and Minds
170.desc: <color=#ffc834>Removes crowd control</color>, <color=#6bc872>increases</color> Physical Attack, and gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> and a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

132.name: Chain Reaction
132.desc: Basic Attack and skill hits place <color=#2bc6ff>stacks</color> on the opponent, dealing extra <color=#ffffff>true damage</color> at max stacks. The number of bullets fired by Skill 1 and Ultimate increases with Attack Speed.

132.name: Resplendent Revolver
132.desc: Fires in the target direction for a period of time and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> while firing.

132.name: Roaming Gun
132.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Blinks</color> in the target direction.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> When enemy heroes are within a certain range, he deals more <color=#6bc872>damage</color> and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

132.name: Fevered Barrage
132.desc: <color=#6bc872>Blinks</color> in the target direction and deals <color=#ff6600>damage over time</color> to enemies within a certain range around him.

138.name: Shifting Mists
138.desc: Gains 1 mark every 5–4s, <color=#ffce49>dodging</color> damage after reaching 5 stacks.

138.name: Misty Mountain
138.desc: Conjures a Misty Mountain at the target location, dealing <color=#db70d0>magical damage</color> over time and <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color> enemies.

138.name: Endless River
138.desc: Releases a river that flows in the target direction, dealing <color=#db70d0>magical damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> enemies.

138.name: One With All
138.desc: Unleashes a mist hairpin that deals <color=#db70d0>magical damage</color> to enemies in its path. He then moves to its location, dealing <color=#db70d0>magical damage</color> over time to a random enemy in range.

558.name: Whirling Featherblades
558.desc:
When attacking at a distance, Basic Attacks throw a blade that returns to her. She can <color=#ffce49>hit the blade as it returns to bounce it back at the enemy,</color> dealing increased damage with each rebound.
When attacking nearby targets, she enters melee mode and attacks faster.
Basic Attacks <color=#ffce49>mark</color> targets. Marked enemies take extra damage from Skill 2.

558.name: Feverish Dance
558.desc: Fires Featherblades at nearby enemies, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and applying <color=#ffce49>marks</color>. Then enters Frenzied state, gaining a major boost to <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6fc075>Attack Speed</color>.

558.name: Feathered Tempest
558.desc:
Dashes forward, <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> and <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> enemies. Also triggers Featherblade marks and spreads them to nearby enemies.
Then, throws rebounding flying blades at enemies in front, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#6fc075>recovering Health</color>. Each hit consumes 1 <color=#ffce49>mark</color> to deal extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color>.

558.name: Final Frenzy
558.desc:
<color=#fa863a>Damages</color> nearby enemies and gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color>. Also enters the <color=#ffce49>Indomitable</color> state for 4s, gaining temporary Health.
If she is defeated while this skill is not on cooldown, she resurrects after a short delay, <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> nearby enemies. The skill will then enter cooldown.
<color=#4f6f95>The Indomitable state ends immediately if she loses all of her temporary Health.</color>

133.name: Swift Justice
133.desc: Each Basic Attack stacks <color=#6bc872>Swift Justice</color> (up to 5 stacks), with each stack increasing his <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

133.name: Respect the Law
133.desc:
Throws tokens in a cone-shaped area, dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color>.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> After every two Basic Attacks, the next Basic Attack gains a random <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> effect.

133.name: Legal Immunity
133.desc: Throws tokens to <color=#ff6600>damage</color> nearby enemies. <color=#ffc834>Removes debuffs</color> from himself and gains <color=#ffc834>brief invincibility</color>.

133.name: Imperial Order
133.desc: Throws a token in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color>, and <color=#2bc6ff>reducing</color> the Physical and Magical Defense of the first enemy hero hit.

134.name: Heart Meridian Mantra
134.desc: When using skills, he <color=#6bc872>gains</color> Physical and Magical Defense, as well as <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> Basic Attacks that inflict extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

134.name: Formlessness Mantra
134.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies and <color=#2dc6ff>crowd controlling</color> them.

134.name: Enlightenment Mantra
134.desc: <color=#ff6600>Damages</color> enemies in front of him and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health.

134.name: Truth Mantra
134.desc: <color=#ff6600>Damages</color> nearby enemies and <color=#2dc6ff>knocks them back</color>. If an enemy is <color=#2dc6ff>knocked back</color> into a wall, they take extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and are <color=#2dc6ff>stunned</color>.

148.name: Sanctification
148.desc:
After hitting a target, gains <color=#ffc834>EXP</color> if it is defeated within 4s.
Upon reaching level , gains <color=#ffc834>Sanctify</color> and <color=#6bc834>increases</color> his level cap to .
Sanctify: <color=#6bc834>Increases</color> a teammate's level cap, with a chance to earn <color=#ffc834>EXP</color>. <color=#ffc834>When playing as support</color>, grants additional Sanctification effects.

148.name: Divine Seal
148.desc: Seals enemies within range, dealing magical <color=#f264ff>damage</color> while <color=#2bc6ff>reducing their Movement Speed</color>, Physical and Magical Defense for 3.5s. If the skill hits any enemy, he gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> boost.

148.name: Divine Punishment
148.desc: Conjures a magic circle that deals 3 strikes of <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in the target area. After a short delay, the magic circle explodes, dealing extra magical <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> enemies for 0.8s.

148.name: Universal Law
148.desc:
Unleashes 3 shockwaves that deal magical <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.
At level 15, the Ultimate's charging speed increases by 10%, and Ziya can move while charging.

135.name: Resolute Will
135.desc:
When his Health drops to a certain level, he gains <color=#ffc834>damage reduction</color>.
Skill uses grant enhanced Basic Attacks.

135.name: Righteous Fervor
135.desc: Dashes forward and <color=#2dc6ff>knocks back</color> the enemy. At the end of the dash, <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> the enemy, deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, and gains an enhanced Basic Attack.

135.name: No Retreat
135.desc: <color=#2dc6ff>Slows</color> nearby enemies and <color=#2dc6ff>reduces</color> their damage output while dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. Gains an enhanced Basic Attack and <color=#6bc872>increased Movement Speed</color>.

135.name: Hegemon's Slash
135.desc:
Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> and <color=#ffc834>Undying</color> while using. Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in the target direction, and deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to and <color=#2dc6ff>stuns</color> nearby enemies.
The lower his Health, the higher the damage.

517.name: Soul Resonance
517.desc: Basic Attacks can connect to an enemy's soul, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> continuously unless the enemy breaks free. When the connection ends, it deals a large amount of <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

517.name: Path of Passing
517.desc: Carves a path to the afterlife, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies hit. The path accelerates when it hits walls or the Life-Death Border, then deals extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. By traversing on the path, he can <color=#ffc834>ignore terrain</color> and gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Hitting a wall for the first time generates an afterlife bridge, and he gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when crossing the bridge while enemies nearby are <color=#2bc6ff>slowed</color>. Using this skill again causes him to enter the <color=#ffc834>Seer State</color>.

517.name: Death's Precipice
517.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and inflicts <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color> on enemies to the front, then generates a Life-Death Border which <color=#f264ff>damages</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color>, and marks enemies who touch it. His next Basic Attack attacks up to 3 additional marked targets, dealing extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> his Health.

517.name: Conductor of Souls
517.desc: Descends from the sky, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>knocking back</color> nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy hero will <color=#6bc872>recover</color> his Health and summon their spirit counterpart to assist him. Enters the <color=#ffc834>Seer State</color> after, in which his Basic Attacks will <color=#ffc834>kill targets with low Health instantly</color>.

174.name: Blessing of the Dryads
174.desc: Basic Attacks have a chance to shoot two bolts in a row and inflict <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

174.name: Oak Bolt
174.desc:
Charges up and shoots a bolt in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in its path.
The higher her Attack Speed, the shorter the charge time.

174.name: Protecting Winds
174.desc:
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack. During this effect, becomes <color=#ffc834>Invulnerable</color> to physical damage.
Upon learning, gains a permanent Attack Speed boost and enhanced Passive effect.

174.name: Vaulting Shot
174.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Jumps</color> at a target, <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color> them, then returns to the original location, gaining an Attack boost and shooting bolts.
The higher her Attack Speed, the more bolts are shot.

137.name: Quiet Whispers
137.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>vision</color> of casters within range. Using this skill will <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> his Basic Attack and deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

137.name: Shadow Stings
137.desc: Summons an <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color> spirit to <color=#6bc872>increase Movement Speed</color>, gaining <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> and dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> after passing through an enemy.

137.name: Barren Lands
137.desc:
Sima Yi <color=#f264ff>damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>silences</color> enemies in the surrounding area.
Passive: Upon taking <color=#f264ff>damage</color>, Sima Yi <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health in proportion to the damage.

137.name: Death Descends
137.desc: Releases a <color=#6bc872>shockwave</color> over the target area, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies upon landing.

139.name: Ancient Wisdom
139.desc:
After landing 5 Basic Attacks, he becomes <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>.
While enhanced, he gains <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Each Basic Attack deals extra <color=#ffffff>true damage</color> and reduces the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skills 1 and 2.

139.name: Corporal Punishment
139.desc: Swings his ferule in the target direction, <color=#2bc6ff>pulling</color> enemies in its path to his location while dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them.

139.name: Intuition
139.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> himself. While enhanced, he <color=#2bc6ff>reflects</color> every enemy hero's 1st Basic Attack and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> them.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> Basic Attacks have a chance of turning into 2 consecutive Basic Attacks.

139.name: Sage's Might
139.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Charges</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to the 1st enemy hero hit and <color=#ffc834>restricting their movement</color> to a fixed area for a while.
Restricted targets <color=#2bc6ff>deal less damage</color>.

162.name: DANCING SWORD ARTS
162.desc: <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> her next Basic Attack after landing a skill hit, dealing extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

162.name: AMUBE YATORO
162.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to a selected enemy and marks them. Damaging a marked enemy triggers the mark, dealing extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and reducing the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> time of the skill.

162.name: RERA MUTSUBE
162.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies and <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health.

162.name: KAMUI MUTSUBE
162.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed boost</color>. Using the skill again deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in the target area, slows them, and <color=#2dc6ff>reduces</color> their damage output.

157.name: HISSATSU SHINOBI-BACHI
157.desc:
Periodically gains an <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> Basic Attack that lets her <color=#6bc872>dash</color> while dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies in her path.
After using an enhanced Basic Attack or any skill, she can roll and gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

157.name: HISHOU RYUUENJIN
157.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward to deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launch</color> enemies in the target area. <color=#6bc872>Recovers Energy</color> upon hit.

157.name: KACHOUSEN
157.desc: Throws her fan to <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color> a target enemy while <color=#2bc6ff>reducing</color> their Magical Defense. Hits <color=#6bc872>recover Energy</color>. After it hits, the fan also deals <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> to the closest unit behind the target.

157.name: CHOU HISSATSU SHINOBI-BACHI
157.desc: Dashes forward to deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>knock back</color> enemies while <color=#2bc6ff>reducing</color> their Physical Attack. <color=#6bc872>Recovers Energy</color> upon hitting a target.

140.name: Rider of Triumph
140.desc:
Normal Stance: Moving constantly accumulates a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> bonus, and reaching a certain distance activates the <color=#6bc872>Charge</color> Stance.
Charge Stance: <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> the next skill and Basic Attack.

140.name: Heroic Charge
140.desc:
Normal Stance: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range.
Charge Stance: <color=#6bc872>Charges</color> forward, <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies in his path while dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

140.name: Soaring Green Dragon
140.desc:
Normal Stance: <color=#ffc834>Removes crowd control effects</color> and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.
Charge Stance: <color=#ffc834>Removes crowd control effects</color> and <color=#6bc872>leaps</color> forward, <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies within the landing area and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

140.name: Razor Cavalry
140.desc:
Normal Stance: <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> himself, reducing the movement distance required to enter Charge stance.
Charge Stance: Summons heavy cavalry that <color=#6bc872>dash</color> forward, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies in their path.

146.name: Moonlight Dance
146.desc: Basic Attacks have two forms, melee and ranged. First Basic Attack in melee form will charge toward the target, and third Basic Attack deals extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. Enhanced Basic Attacks and skill damage <color=#2dc6ff>mark</color> enemies. Magical Attack boost will <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> her Attack Speed.

146.name: Crescent Slice
146.desc: Unleashes a shockwave in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#ffc834>marking</color> enemies hit.

146.name: Searing Stab
146.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> and pulls nearby enemies, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> while <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color>, and <color=#ffc834>marking</color> them.

146.name: New Moon
146.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> to the target location, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in her path.
If she hits a marked enemy, <color=#ffc834>this skill's cooldown is reset</color>.

584.name: Flow of the World
584.desc:
Channels the Flow into the body to gain <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and enhance one of four stats: <color=#6bc872>Health/Attack/Movement Speed/Cooldown</color>.
Can spend Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals piercing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color>.

584.name: Convergence
584.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> to nearby enemies and <color=#2bc6ff>knocks them back</color>. Gains <color=#6bc872>Health recovery</color>, 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of Arrow of No Retreat and Arrowstorm.

584.name: Arrow of No Retreat
584.desc: Shoots an enormous projectile at the target, dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>knocking back</color> non-hero units. Can dash a short distance after use.

584.name: Arrowstorm
584.desc: Shoots multiple light projectiles at the target area, dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and gaining <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

141.name: Explosion of Fragrance
141.desc: Applies <color=#2bc6ff>stacks</color> to the opponent. At max stacks, deals <color=#ffffff>area damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> enemies, while <color=#6bc872>recovering Health</color>.

141.name: Returning Lotus
141.desc: Sends out a lotus in the target direction that returns to her when it reaches its max distance, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies in its path.

141.name: Petals in the Wind
141.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, becoming <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color> during the dash. Releases petals to attack nearby enemies, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and reducing the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skill 2.

141.name: Flowery Potential
141.desc: Conjures up a magic circle around her, which lasts for a period of time. While she is within the circle, the <color=#6bc872>cooldowns</color> of Skill 1 and Skill 2 are sped up. The circle deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within it when it is conjured and when it expires.

142.name: Flame Incantation
142.desc: Hitting enemies with skills increases <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

142.name: Chaos Cinder
142.desc: Fires a large fireball in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and inflicting <color=#2bc6ff>stun</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.

142.name: Blazing Brilliance
142.desc:
Channels a blazing beam in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time.
Also gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> and <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color>.

154.name: Great Wall Guardian
154.desc:
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when using dual swords.
Skills and Basic Attacks apply marks to enemies. At 5 stacks, the marks detonate, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and inflicting <color=#2dc6ff>silence</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color> on the enemy.

154.name: Snaking Strike
154.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> twice in the target direction, with the ability to change the direction of the 2nd <color=#6bc872>dash</color>.
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in her path.
If the skill hits an enemy, it can be used again before it enters cooldown.

154.name: Dagger Waltz
154.desc:
Throws a sword in the target direction that <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> and deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range when it reaches its max range.
If Mulan touches the sword, she retrieves it, reducing the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skill 2.

154.name: Blooming Blade
154.desc:
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range, gaining <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> during this time.
<color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> herself, gaining Physical Attack for a period of time.
<color=#ffc834>Switches</color> to heavy sword form.

149.name: Royal Ambition
149.desc: Gains 1 mark every second, for up to 4 marks. Basic Attacks expend all marks, dealing additional <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> per mark. At maximum marks, the next Basic Attack is <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> into a ranged attack.

149.name: Dominator's Shield
149.desc: Grants himself a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>. If the shield is still not depleted when it expires, it will deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.

149.name: Staggering Charge
149.desc: Charges up and <color=#6bc872>dashes</color> forward, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> enemies in his path.

149.name: Battlefield Command
149.desc: Provides a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> to a teammate. After a short delay, <color=#ffc834>teleports</color> to the teammate and <color=#6bc872>gains Movement Speed</color>.

533.name: Mountain Encounter
533.desc: Replaces Recovery with <color=#ffc834>Release</color>. Upon releasing monsters, they grant her Gold, EXP, and their respective <color=#ffc834>blessing</color>. Her Basic Attacks drop Seed Mines.

533.name: Wild Growth
533.desc: Agudo grants <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and Health <color=#6bc872>recovery</color> to herself and summons in the target area, and summons multiple monsters at the center.

533.name: Tumble, Furball!
533.desc: Rolls forward, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Gains <color=#ffc834>immunity</color> against 1 hard crowd control, and <color=#ff6600>damages</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies hit.

533.name: Gorge Mobilization
533.desc: <color=#ffc834>Summons</color> Furball to leap to the target location, inflicting <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>crowd control</color>. Furball then fights independently.

152.name: Frozen Heart
152.desc:
Upon leaving combat, gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> that <color=#2bc6ff>chills</color> the attacker when taking damage.
When the shield disappears, deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.
Every third Basic Attack is <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>, inflicting extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>chill</color> effects.

152.name: Shattered Ice
152.desc: <color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> enemies in the target area while gaining <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of them.

152.name: Frigid Prison
152.desc: After a short delay, <color=#2bc6ff>freezes</color> enemies in the target area and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> them. Attacking frozen targets will deal <color=#f264ff>extra damage</color>.

152.name: Winter Is Here
152.desc: Summons a snowstorm in the target location, constantly dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.

155.name: Elf Dance
155.desc:
Her Basic Attack grants Energy. At max Energy, she <color=#6bc872>speeds up</color>, gains a stack of Laurel, and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> her next Basic Attack.
<color=#4f6f95>The speed-up increases with her Magical Attack.</color>
<color=#4f6f95>Her Pierce and Lifesteal stats are linked, using whichever is higher.</color>

155.name: Dance - Leaf Greeting
155.desc:
Shoots a leaf to deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and gain <color=#ffc834>marks</color>. The leaf then forms a circle, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.
<color=#4f6f95>Magical Attack reduces the skill's cooldown.</color>

155.name: Twirl - Forest Whisper
155.desc: Recovers full Energy and gains <color=#ffc834>marks</color>, <color=#ffc834>immunity to slow</color>, and <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>.

155.name: Waltz - Laurel Bloom
155.desc: This skill is unlocked when Erin gains enough Laurels. She consumes Laurels to deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>gain Movement Speed</color>, while reducing the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> of Skill 2.

178.name: Mind Games
178.desc: Yang Jian's Basic Attack and skills can stack Resistance. After attaining max stacks, he gains crowd control immunity. If Yang Jian enters battle with a hero, he will enter the Heaven-Earth Form.

178.name: Unleash the Hound
178.desc: Commands Heaven Hound to pounce in the target direction, <color=#2dc6ff>marking</color> the first enemy hit and <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> them. Upon using the skill again, he <color=#6bc872>charges to the target</color> and deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

178.name: Vain Disillusionment
178.desc: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in front, <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them. If he hits an enemy, he gains an enhanced Basic Attack that deals extra <color=#ffffff>damage</color>.

178.name: Sight of Origin
178.desc: Unleashes beams of light that deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>restore</color> his Health.

173.name: Going Undercover
173.desc: Periodically <color=#ffc834>reveals</color> enemy heroes within range. Deals <color=#ff6600>extra physical damage</color> against monsters and minions.

173.name: Target Sighted
173.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Marks</color> the target enemy while increasing his own <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Range</color>.
Attacking the marked target adds stacks, increasing the marks' damage.
Upon reaching max stacks or when the marks expire, the marks explode, dealing <color=#ff6600>area damage</color>.

173.name: Wheel Away
173.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path. He is <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color> while dashing.
Scorches the ground in his path, <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range.

173.name: Bladestorm
173.desc: Throws his blade to the target location, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage over time</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies within range.

156.name: Power Word - Trance
156.desc: Every second hit on the same target within a short time will deal an extra strike of <color=#ffffff>damage</color>.

156.name: Power Word - Barrier
156.desc:
Summons 4 barriers that shatter when touched by an enemy, inflicting <color=#f264ff>damage</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>stun</color>, and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>.
<color=#f264ff>Damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> effects are reduced for enemies that touch multiple barriers.

156.name: Power Word - Fate
156.desc:
Conjures a magic circle that deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range while granting <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of the area.
Liang gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> while inside his magic circle.

156.name: Power Word - Control
156.desc: <color=#ffc834>Suppresses</color> an enemy hero, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time. When the suppression is complete, deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>stuns</color> enemies in range.

514.name: Howling Blade
514.desc: Basic Attacks and skills grant <color=#6bc872>Fury</color>, which <color=#6bc872>increases his Physical Pierce</color> and <color=#6bc872>Magical Pierce</color> and grants <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color>. At max Fury, he <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health, and the lower his Health, the more he recovers.

514.name: Meteor Kill
514.desc: Based on how many stacks of mark he has, deals multi-phase <color=#ffc834>damage</color> in the target direction and <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies. He gains marks by hitting enemies with Basic Attacks and his Ultimate.

514.name: Moonlight Flash
514.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies. He gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and his next 3 Basic Attacks gain increased <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>.

514.name: Death at Sunset
514.desc: <color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> toward the targeted enemy hero and becomes <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color>. After a short delay, he lands and deals <color=#f264ff>area damage</color>. For every enemy hero hit, he gains <color=#6bc872>marks</color> and <color=#6bc872>Fury</color>. He also gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> based on the number of enemies hit.

163.name: CONCEALED SABRE HAZY BLADE
163.desc: Every 4–5s, Ukyo Tachibana gains one <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> Basic Attack that has <color=#6bc872>increased range</color>, <color=#6bc872>restores Health</color>, deals <color=#ff6600>extra damage</color>, and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> enemies. Dealing skill damage shortens the enhanced Basic Attack's <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color>.

163.name: CONCEALED SABRE SWALLOW SWIPE
163.desc:
Ukyo Tachibana creates a domain around himself, then <color=#6bc872>leaps backward</color>, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path. This skill can be used again after 2s, or immediately if it hits a target.
If he returns to the starting point of phase 1 after using phase 2, phase 2 is <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>.

163.name: CONCEALED SABRE HEAVENLY HACK
163.desc:
Slashes in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range.
Enemies at the edge of the skill's range will be <color=#2bc6ff>stunned</color>.

163.name: CONCEALED SABRE SNOWFALL SLASH
163.desc:
Slashes 4 times in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range.
<color=#6bc872>Recovers</color> Health each time damage is dealt.

180.name: Scorching Ember
180.desc: Gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> and a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> that negates true damage when attacking the enemy.

180.name: Fire-tipped Spear - Sweep
180.desc: Attacks nearby enemies, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color>. This attack also <color=#50c1eb>weakens</color> the recovery capability of heroes and deals <color=#d9d9d9>true damage</color> over time.

180.name: Red Armillary Sash - Bind
180.desc: Flips behind the target to deal <color=#fa863a>damage</color>.

180.name: Universe Ring - Skyfall
180.desc: <color=#ffce49>Flies</color> to a target, dealing damage and <color=#50c1eb>knocking them back</color>. When he reaches the target area, he gains <color=#ffce49>damage reduction</color> and <color=#ffce49>Resistance</color>.

180.name: Universe Ring
180.desc: Unleashes the universe ring, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemy heroes across the entire map and gaining <color=#6fc075>vision</color>. Enhances the range of Universe Ring - Skyfall to cover the entire map for 5s.

167.name: The Great Sage
167.desc: Using skills <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack to a <color=#6bc872>dash</color> strike that deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. He has a higher base Critical Rate but lower base Critical Damage than other heroes.

167.name: Protective Shroud
167.desc:
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#ffc834>blocks</color> the next enemy skill's damage and effects.
Upon a successful block, grants temporary damage and skill <color=#ffc834>invulnerability</color> along with a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

167.name: Furious Advance
167.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction. If he dashes into an enemy, he'll <color=#6bc872>dash again</color> and gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. The dash deals <color=#ffffff>damage</color> to monsters, and <color=#ffc834>grievous</color> damage to monsters at low Health.

167.name: Golden Cudgel
167.desc: <color=#2bc6ff>Launches</color> enemies within range, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and placing 3 <color=#2dc6ff>marks</color> on them. Enemies lose 1 mark and take extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> when hit by his Basic Attack.

168.name: Sea Beast's Favor
168.desc: <color=#6bc872>Increases</color> the Physical and Magical Defense of himself and the teammate with the lowest Health nearby.

168.name: Island's Blessing
168.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path and <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> them.

168.name: Raging Sea
168.desc: Splits the earth, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> enemies within range and <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> them. The fractured earth <color=#ff6600>damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> enemies.

171.name: Dark Potential
171.desc:
Human Form: Basic Attack and skill hits grant <color=#6bc872>Madness</color>.
Ferali Form: Using the skill <color=#2dc6ff>reduces</color> the Movement Speed of enemies within range.

171.name: Forbidden Domain
171.desc:
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within range.
<color=#4f6f95><color=#2dc6ff>Knocks back</color> enemy heroes.</color>

171.name: Leaping Savior
171.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> to the target location, granting <color=#6bc872>shields</color> to nearby teammates.
<color=#4f6f95>Gains Madness for each shield granted.</color>

171.name: Unbridled Outburst
171.desc:
Roars and <color=#ffc834>transforms</color>. After a short period of <color=#ffc834>invincibility</color> and <color=#ffc834>immunity to crowd control</color>, gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.
The roar creates a wind that <color=#ff6600>damages</color>, <color=#2dc6ff>knocks back</color>, and <color=#2dc6ff>stuns</color> enemies.
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> while in the wind zone.

175.name: Ethereal Outburst
175.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>area damage</color> upon taking heavy damage in a single hit or after dying.

175.name: Mortals!
175.desc: <color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> nearby enemies. Marks enemies in the inner circle while dealing extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.

175.name: Join Me
175.desc:
Throws a chain hook in the target direction that <color=#2dc6ff>pulls the target back</color>, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and marking them.
Passive: Defeats and assists permanently boost Health.

175.name: Into the Void
175.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> multiple times and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> enemies within range. Against <color=#2bc6ff>marked</color> heroes, the slow effect is upgraded to a <color=#2bc6ff>stun</color>.

176.name: Poignant Melodies
176.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Changes</color> the melody to produce different skill effects.
War: Skills deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.
Peace: Skills <color=#6bc872>heal</color> nearby allies.

176.name: Tragic Beauty
176.desc: <color=#f264ff>Damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> nearby targets. Her next Basic Attack will deal more <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

176.name: Mournful Tempo
176.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>, and after a brief delay, inflicts <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>stun</color> on enemies in the target area.

176.name: Unending Sorrow
176.desc: Becomes <color=#ffc834>untargetable</color>, and after a brief delay, she <color=#6bc872>heals</color> teammates within range and deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies.

176.name: Melody of Peace
176.desc: <color=#ffc834>Changes</color> the melody to Peace, in which skills <color=#6bc872>restore</color> Health to nearby allies.

177.name: Hunting
177.desc: Whenever he moves through brush, gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> his next Basic Attack to a double shot that deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. Leaps when emerging from brush.

177.name: Soaring Signal
177.desc: Leaps into the air, gaining <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and allowing him to <color=#ffc834>traverse terrain</color>. While airborne, his Basic Attack fires a powerful arrow, dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies.

177.name: Lupine Trap
177.desc: Throws a wolf spirit trap at a target location. When triggered, it deals <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> and <color=#ffc834>summons</color> a wolf spirit to attack the enemy.

177.name: Leader Stance
177.desc: <color=#ffc834>Summons</color> wolf spirits and gains the ability to shoot while moving. Also boosts <color=#6bc872>Physical Attack, Movement Speed, and Attack Speed</color> for 8s.

503.name: Fearless Chariot
503.desc: Charges up when Basic Attacks and unenhanced skills hit. Charged skills gain <color=#6bc872>extra effects</color>. When charged to at least 1 bars, Basic Attacks <color=#6bc872>recover Health</color> on hit.

503.name: Electrifying Charge
503.desc: Swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health with every hit. The enhanced skill deals more <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> more Health.

503.name: Storm Strike
503.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction and causes the next Basic Attack to deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color> the enemy. The enhanced skill deals increased <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and also <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> the enemy.

503.name: Force Field Suppression
503.desc:
<color=#ff6600>Damages</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> nearby enemies while gaining a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.
The enhanced skill deals more <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, grants a stronger <color=#6bc872>shield</color>, and generates an electric wave that <color=#ff6600>damages</color> nearby enemies while stealing <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> from enemy heroes.

179.name: Divine Consciousness
179.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> vision and range when leveling up.

179.name: Divine Glow - Creation
179.desc: Unleashes energy that deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color>, <color=#2dc6ff>knocks back</color> enemies, and creates a matrix. When the energy stops, it expands to deal extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

179.name: Divine Glow - Coalescence
179.desc: Creates a <color=#ffc834>matrix</color> that she can <color=#ffc834>jump over</color> but <color=#ffc834>blocks</color> enemy heroes' movement. Matrices can be fused twice and set off explosions if hit by her other skills.

179.name: Divine Glow - Emergence
179.desc: <color=#ffc834>Teleports</color> to the target area after a short delay. Generates a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>, gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>, deals damage, and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> the enemy.

179.name: Divine Glow - Annihilation
179.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to targets in a straight line across the map.

182.name: Forever Entwined
182.desc:
Basic Attacks deal extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. <color=#ffc834>Flying sword skills have a shared usage cap</color>.
When flying swords hit, place Sword Energy on targets, and flying swords deal extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to targets marked with Sword Energy.

182.name: Guard Her Grave
182.desc: Unleashes Splitting Sword and <color=#6bc872>moves</color> backwards, <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies and dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> while reducing their Magical Defense.

182.name: Coupled Blades - Short
182.desc: Throws flying swords that deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in their path.

182.name: Coupled Blades - Long
182.desc: Throws flying swords that deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in their path.

182.name: Freshly Forged
182.desc:
Immediately gains 2 uses of flying sword skill and summons more swords to <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> the next flying sword skill.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> <color=#6bc872>Increases</color> field of vision and <color=#6bc872>grants</color> one additional use of Coupled Blades. Each time a flying sword hits an enemy, the cooldown of Freshly Forged is <color=#6bc872>reduced</color>.

183.name: Divine Awakening
183.desc: Able to move in her <color=#ffce49>Divine</color> form after dying. When resurrected, flies toward the nearest allied tower, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> enemies within takeoff range.

183.name: Holy Advance
183.desc: Raises her shield and dashes, <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> and dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> to enemies while gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> that grants crowd control immunity.

183.name: Unstoppable Spear
183.desc: Dashes in the target direction and <color=#6fc075>enhances</color> the next Basic Attack, in which she charges at the enemy and deals <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to them.

183.name: Immovable Aegis
183.desc: Raises a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> that grants <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color>. Damage taken while the shield is up will be returned after a brief delay, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> to enemies within range.

193.name: Demon Soul
193.desc: Basic Attacks and Skill 2 deal extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to single targets.

193.name: Vortex Brand
193.desc:
Throws a ricocheting blade in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies hit.
The blade returns on hit, <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health and granting <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>.

193.name: Blade Tempest
193.desc:
Slashes twice, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. The second slash <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> enemies and <color=#6bc872>increases</color> the <color=#ff6600>damage</color> of the next Basic Attack.
Gains increased Health and Mana <color=#6bc872>recovery</color>, and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when out of combat.

193.name: Invincible Warrior
193.desc: Becomes <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color>, gaining <color=#6bc872>max Health</color>, <color=#6bc872>Physical Attack</color>, and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>, while <color=#ffc834>blocking</color> incoming damage and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage over time</color> to nearby enemies.

184.name: Can't Touch This
184.desc: Periodic Passive Effect: <color=#6bc872>Recovers</color> Health and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when taking damage.

184.name: Healing Hymn
184.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and continuously <color=#6bc872>heals</color> teammates within a certain range.

184.name: Earworm
184.desc:
Fires a sound wave in the target direction, <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color> and <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies hit.
Sound waves bounce between nearby enemies.

184.name: Tune of Tranquility
184.desc: Continuously <color=#6bc872>heals</color> the teammate with the lowest Health within range, while granting them <color=#6bc872>Physical and Magical Defense</color>.

198.name: Dream-eating
198.desc: Gains Mass when using skills. Mass increases his Physical Attack, Physical Defense, and Magical Defense.

198.name: Lingering Dream
198.desc:
Gains Mass and a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> while <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies within range.
Basic Attack hits <color=#6bc872>reduce</color> this skill's cooldown.

198.name: Dream Bubble
198.desc:
Throws a bubble in the target direction, then pulls it back. He does this twice.
The bubble <color=#f264ff>damages</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> enemies hit.
The bubble can be thrown again as a bomb in the target direction, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies.

198.name: Dream Roam
198.desc: Flies in a circle, dealing <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> to enemies in his path while gaining Mass. When he stops flying, he <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> and <color=#f264ff>damages</color> nearby enemies.

187.name: Soul Sacrifice
187.desc: Every time a dark orb passes through an enemy, it deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and restores <color=#6bc872>Health</color> to him.

187.name: Eclipse
187.desc:
Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range and summons a dark orb. There can be 3 dark orbs at a time.
Hitting enemies with this skill reduces its <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color>, and with 3 dark orbs, it <color=#6bc872>restores</color> Health.

187.name: Dark Impact
187.desc:
Unleashes up to 3 dark orbs at the target location, <color=#6bc872>increasing his Movement Speed</color> and dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in range.
The 1st and 2nd dark orbs <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color> enemies.
The 3rd dark orb <color=#2dc6ff>stuns</color> enemies.

187.name: Forsaken Contract
187.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Suppresses</color> an enemy hero and summons 3 dark orbs.
If he or the target takes damage during suppression, the other will take the same amount of <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

189.name: The Laws of Nature
189.desc: After leaving the enemy's vision, the next Basic Attack deals extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slows</color> the enemy.

189.name: Prophecy - Hidden Hand
189.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed boost</color> and <color=#ffc834>camouflages</color> himself, reducing the Physical and Magical Defense of enemies touched while dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to them.

189.name: The Animist
189.desc: Summons spriteflies, and after a brief delay, <color=#2bc6ff>pulls in</color> nearby enemies, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>stunning</color> them. If he hits an enemy hero, he and nearby teammates gain a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

189.name: Prophecy - Out of Sight
189.desc:
After 1s, <color=#ffc834>camouflages</color> and grants <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> to himself and nearby teammates.
Gains <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of the nearest enemy hero.
<color=#4f6f95>The disguise breaks upon using Basic Attacks, skills, or actions that affect enemies.</color>

195.name: Crazed Prelude
195.desc: Deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies at long range and <color=#2dc6ff>slows</color> them, while gaining a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed boost</color>.

195.name: Flailing Sickles
195.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, <color=#2bc6ff>pulling</color> enemies marked by his sickle a certain distance. Also <color=#6bc872>enhances his next Basic Attack</color>.

195.name: Nightmare Hooks
195.desc: Charges up and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. After charging, he throws the sickle to immobilize enemies and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, marking the first enemy hit. Using the skill again will <color=#2dc6ff>pull back</color> and <color=#ff6600>damage</color> the marked enemy.

195.name: Crimson Blur
195.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> behind a target marked by his sickle, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. Beyond a certain range, he <color=#6bc872>moves</color> toward the target instead.
If he has not marked a target, the hook latches onto one, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. Takes <color=#ffc834>50% less damage</color> during the dash.
<color=#ffc834>Passive: Kills and assists grant Movement Speed and Attack Speed, up to 3 stacks.</color>

190.name: Time for Tactics
190.desc: Active skill hits on enemies grant 1 stack. At the max of 5 stacks, he summons prisms to attack nearby enemies.

190.name: Arcane Assault
190.desc: Fires 3 prisms in a cone-shaped area, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies hit.

190.name: Time Shift
190.desc: <color=#6bc872>Teleports</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies near the start and end points.

190.name: Winning Strategy
190.desc:
Channels briefly and unleashes a Spirit Bomb at the target enemy, dealing grievous <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.
If the bomb defeats an enemy hero, the skill's <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> is reduced by 80%.

191.name: Law of Infinity
191.desc: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Her tide can be triggered again by the skill to deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

191.name: Leaping Koi Tide
191.desc: <color=#2dc6ff>Launches</color> and <color=#f264ff>damages</color> enemies in a line ahead, leaving a tide that deals continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when using skills.

191.name: Sea of Fate
191.desc: Conjures a portal that allows a teammate to <color=#ffc834>recall</color> and come back.

191.name: Severing Surge
191.desc: <color=#2dc6ff>Launches</color> and <color=#f264ff>damages</color> enemies along a line, leaving a tide that deals continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

191.name: Eye of the Whirlpool
