191.desc: Conjures a magic circle that deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color>, lets her teammates <color=#ffc834>teleport</color> to it, and gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

192.name: Gunner's Spirit
192.desc: Basic Attacks increase <color=#6bc872>Physical Attack</color> and <color=#6bc872>Critical Rate</color>.

192.name: Unleash Your Potential
192.desc: Gains a <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> boost. Exits Turret Mode if it is active. Permanently gains <color=#6bc872>Physical Attack</color> upon learning.

192.name: Lay the Mines
192.desc: Places a <color=#2bc6ff>trap</color> in the target area. The trap grants <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of enemies that trigger it, while also inflicting <color=#ff6600>damage</color>, <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>, and <color=#2bc6ff>sunder</color> on them and granting Huang Zhong a <color=#6bc872>shield</color>.

192.name: Bring out the Artillery
192.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> and deploys a <color=#f3b74a>turret</color> while <color=#6bc872>refreshing</color> his Skill 1.
He becomes immobile, gains <color=#6bc872>Attack Range</color>, and <color=#6bc872>increases</color> his Physical and Magical Defense. Basic Attacks deal <color=#ff6600>area damage</color>.
The turret will be deactivated after a certain number of Basic Attacks.

196.name: Accuracy
196.desc: When out of combat, gains marks that increase his <color=#ff6600>Physical Pierce</color> and <color=#ff6600>Basic Attack damage</color>. Hitting enemy heroes with Basic Attacks or skills will consume marks. When his Attack Speed reaches certain thresholds, he gains marks faster.

196.name: The Tranquil Eye
196.desc:
Places a device that grants <color=#ffc834>vision</color>.
<color=#f3b74a>Passive</color>: When out of combat and near natural terrain or a scouting device, he <color=#fc834>disguises</color> himself, gaining <color=#6BC872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6BC872>Attack Speed</color>.

196.name: Wild Wind
196.desc: Snipes in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> targets. This skill will be enhanced when his Attack Speed reaches certain thresholds.

196.name: Getaway
196.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> backward and fires in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> the target hit while gaining increased <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Bullets stocked are shared with Skill 2.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> Increases Basic Attack <color=#6bc872>range</color>.

640.name: Whisperwind
640.desc: Gains Mana and increased cooldown speed while moving. If there are teammates nearby, also gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color>.

640.name: Gust Force
640.desc:
Conjures a persistent magic circle at the target location.
The magic circle <color=#db70d0>damages</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slows</color> enemy units.
The magic circle grants <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> to teammates.

640.name: Wind Cuffs
640.desc:
Fires an orb in the target direction, gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> and <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color>.
The orb <color=#db70d0>damages</color> enemies it hits.
The orb grants a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> to teammates it hits.
If the orb passes through a Gust Force magic circle, it pushes the magic circle to its destination.

640.name: Hurricane Wall
640.desc:
Conjures a barrier<color=#4f6f95></color> around herself, <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> enemies and dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color>. Enemies that touch the barrier take <color=#db70d0>damage</color> and are <color=#50c1eb>stunned</color>. Teammates within the barrier gain <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color>.
<color=#ffce49>Untargetable</color> while channeling.

197.name: Maintaining Initiative
197.desc: Basic Attacks deal <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color>. For every 4 skill hits on the same enemy, generates a Weiqi stone that deals <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> and adds to the total number of Weiqi stones. Upon taking fatal damage, gains brief <color=#ffc834>immunity</color> to all damage and increased <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

197.name: Sliding Stones
197.desc:
Places a Weiqi stone at the target location, gaining <color=#ffc834>vision</color> and <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies.
Weiqi stones will be pulled into Skill 2's Weiqi formation, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies in their path.

197.name: Taking Liberties
197.desc: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to the target area and creates a Weiqi formation. The formation <color=#2dc6ff>pulls</color> enemies toward its center, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> them in the process.

197.name: The World is My Board
197.desc: Draws a Weiqi board that <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> enemies and places <color=#2dc6ff>marks</color> on them while <color=#ffc834>exposing</color> their location. Enemies caught within the Weiqi board are <color=#ffc834>bound</color> and will be unable to leave. Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> while forming the board.

199.name: Falling Leaves
199.desc:
Basic Attack hits place <color=#2dc6ff>marks</color> on the target. At max marks, <color=#ff6600>damage</color> is dealt to them.
Using skills grants a follow-up Basic Attack.
Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> while parasol is away.

199.name: Maple Dance
199.desc: <color=#ffc834>Knocks down</color> nearby projectiles and deals 2 strikes of <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

199.name: Autumn Storm
199.desc: <color=#2dc6ff>Knocks back</color> enemies in the target area and deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.

534.name: Firefly Protection
534.desc: Basic Attacks and skills summon fireflies that deal extra <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies and grant <color=#ffc834>vision</color> of them. Periodically <color=#6bc872>heals</color> teammates, or can charge up his Basic Attack to <color=#6bc872>heal</color> himself instead.

534.name: Mulberry Power
534.desc: <color=#2dc6ff>Launches</color> and <color=#f264ff>damages</color> enemies in front while summoning fireflies to <color=#6bc872>heal</color> teammates or <color=#f264ff>damage</color> enemies.

534.name: Ride the Wind
534.desc: <color=#6bc872>Flies</color> to a brush while summoning fireflies that <color=#6bc872>heal</color> teammates or <color=#f264ff>damage</color> enemies.

534.name: Firefly Fields
534.desc: Summons a <color=#ffc834>brush</color> and can fly into it by using this skill again. The brush summons fireflies over time that <color=#6bc872>heal</color> teammates or <color=#f264ff>damage</color> enemies.

501.name: Good Omens
501.desc: Every 5s, Ming's next Basic Attack deals magical <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>heals</color> himself and the linked teammate. The healing is reduced if the enemy is not a hero.

501.name: Time - Carefree
501.desc:
Throws his instrument and links it to a teammate, <color=#6bc872>increasing</color> their main attack stat and Attack Speed.
Enemies who touch the link take <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time.
<color=#ffc834>Passive</color>: <color=#6bc872>Increases</color> Ming's Physical Attack, Magical Attack, and Movement Speed.

501.name: Mastery - Glide
501.desc:
Throws his instrument and links it to an enemy, <color=#2dc6ff>reducing</color> their Physical and Magical Defense.
Enemies who touch the link take <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time.
<color=#ffc834>Passive:</color> <color=#6bc872>Gains</color> Physical and Magical Defense.

501.name: Peace - Longevity
501.desc: Ming channels for a short time before sacrificing Health to deal <color=#ffffff>true damage</color> to the linked enemy or <color=#6bc872>heal</color> the linked teammate. If linked to both, he <color=#6bc872>does not lose Health</color>.

502.name: Blast
502.desc: In human form, Basic Attacks have increased <color=#6bc872>range</color> and deal extra <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> while <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Energy. Consecutive hits on the same target will stack damage.

502.name: Striker Stance
502.desc:
Fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in its path and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them.
Recovers Energy upon hit.

502.name: Guarding Stance
502.desc:
Gains a <color=#6bc872>shield</color> and <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color>.
Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range and continues to deal <color=#f264ff>damage over time</color>.

502.name: Tiger Form
502.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Switches</color> to tiger form, gaining <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> the next 2 Basic Attacks.
The 1st Basic Attack lets him <color=#6bc872>dash</color> toward a locked-on target, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them.
The 2nd Basic Attack deals <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color>.

504.name: Mechanical Minions
504.desc: <color=#ffc834>Summons</color> minions upon killing a unit. Minions attack automatically, then merge into an advanced bot or explode at the end of their duration, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.

504.name: Air Superiority
504.desc:
Commands her aircraft to move in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies in its path.
Using the skill again splits the aircraft in two, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.

504.name: Forced Invasion
504.desc: <color=#ffc834>Summons</color> mechanical minions in the target area, dealing area <color=#f264ff>damage</color> before automatically attacking nearby enemies.

504.name: Chaos Field
504.desc:
Marks a target enemy or structure, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> them over time. Non-structures are also <color=#2bc6ff>stunned</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowed</color>. Nearby mechanical minions are <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> while the mark is active.
The mark explodes upon expiry, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> proportional to the <color=#f264ff>damage</color> taken while marked.

505.name: Deer Spirit
505.desc: When inflicted with crowd control effects (excluding suppression), gains <color=#ffc834>immunity</color> to all effects.

505.name: Wandering Beam
505.desc:
Releases a soul in the target direction, which <color=#ffc834>tracks</color> nearby enemies after reaching its max range.
The soul <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> and deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies hit.
In deer spirit form, using this skill will restore her to Human Form.

505.name: Accelerating Blitz
505.desc:
Deals continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to nearby enemies.
<color=#ffc834>Attached:</color> <color=#6bc872>Increased range</color>.

505.name: Verdant Protector
505.desc:
Attaches herself to a teammate, providing a <color=#ffc834>true damage shield</color> and <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> her own skill effects.
<color=#ffc834>Attached:</color> When the shield is exhausted, the attachment ends and the skill goes on cooldown. Actively detaching reduces the <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color>.

506.name: Through the Clouds
506.desc: <color=#ffc834>Ignores terrain</color> after reaching level 4 and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when using Basic Attacks. Enemies hit by his Basic Attacks or skills take <color=#ff6600>damage</color> when they move.

506.name: Cloud Descending
506.desc: Charges up, <color=#6bc872>gaining Movement Speed</color>. Then dashes forward, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>stunning</color> enemies. Can jump back if he hits a hero.

506.name: Razor Wind
506.desc: Throws wind blades that <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color> and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies 2 times. Then gains <color=#6bc872>Attack Speed</color> and ranged Basic Attacks.

506.name: Soaring Whirlwind
506.desc: Carries an enemy hero into the air, then strikes the ground, dealing <color=#ff6600>area damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launching</color> the enemy he carried.

507.name: Ashen Razor
507.desc: Gains <color=#6fc075>EXP</color> when hitting enemy heroes with Basic Attacks and Chaos Wave.

507.name: Chaos Wave
507.desc: Unleashes sword energy, <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color> the target.

507.name: Light Awakening
507.desc: <color=#ffce49>Transforms</color> into Domination Form and gains new skills.

507.name: Dark Awakening
507.desc: <color=#ffce49>Transforms</color> into Revenge form. This process cannot be interrupted and is faster at higher skill levels.

508.name: Piercing Arrow
508.desc: Basic Attacks and skills deal <color=#6bc872>50%</color> extra damage to shields.

508.name: Enchanted Arrows
508.desc:
Enhanced: <color=#6bc872>Attack Range</color> and Basic Attack interval increase. Basic Attacks cost Mana and deal <color=#f264ff>damage</color> over time.
Unenhanced: Gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and restores Attack Range and Basic Attack interval to initial values. Basic Attack hits <color=#6bc872>restore Mana</color>.

508.name: Silent Arrow
508.desc: Fires an arrow in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit while <color=#2bc6ff>silencing</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them. After a brief delay, deals another strike of <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range of the same location.

508.name: Sphere of Purity
508.desc:
Creates a magic circle, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>increasing</color> her Movement Speed and Critical Rate.
When the circle is destroyed, it deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>increases</color> her Critical Rate and <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

509.name: Moving Mountain
509.desc:
Basic Attacks deal extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color>.
While protecting a teammate and when in turret mode, Basic Attacks deal ranged damage and inflict <color=#50c1eb>slow</color>.

509.name: Bastion
509.desc:
Select a teammate: Dashes to the target, then <color=#f3b74a>shelters</color> them, granting both himself and the teammate a <color=#6fc075>shield</color>. The teammate controls both heroes' movement during this time.
Select an allied tower or any tower ruins: Merges with the tower, becoming a turret and gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color>. Becomes <color=#f3b74a>untargetable</color> and <color=#6fc075>recovers</color> Health every second. Restores the same amount of Health to the tower and grants it a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> of equal strength.

509.name: Collision Course
509.desc: Charges forward, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and tossing back the first enemy hero hit and nearby targets. Thrown targets <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>stun</color> nearby enemies upon landing.

509.name: Allshield
509.desc: Deploys a giant shield, <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color>, <color=#fa863a>damaging</color>, and <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color> enemies. The shield then travels forward, <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> and <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> enemies it touches while <color=#f3b74a>knocking down</color> projectiles.

510.name: Raging Tide
510.desc: The next Basic Attack periodically deals extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>restores</color> Health. Gains 1 stack every time a skill deals damage, or every time he takes physical or true damage, for up to 10 stacks. Each stack <color=#6bc872>increases</color> Physical Defense.

510.name: Wave Render
510.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path and at the end of his dash. After a short delay, <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies and deals further <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

510.name: Typhoon
510.desc: Strides forward and sweeps enemies in front, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them. Can sweep an extra 2 times before the skill goes into cooldown.

510.name: Set Sail!
510.desc:
<color=#ffc834>Pilots a boat</color> forward and <color=#ffc834>becomes immune to crowd control</color>. The boat can also <color=#6bc872>carry 1 teammate</color>.
When it hits obstacles or certain enemies, it explodes and <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
If he bails out early, the boat will coast for a distance.

646.name: Assassination
646.desc: Gains 2 stacks of mark from defeating heroes and 1 stack from assisting or killing monsters and minion waves. At 3 stacks of mark, the next skill used will not enter cooldown.

646.name: Whirlwind
646.desc: Deals <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemies around her and gains a <color=#6fc075>shield</color>. Her <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed increases</color> during this time.

646.name: Sword Propel
646.desc: Deals <color=#fa863a>damage</color> in the target direction and inflicts <color=#50c1eb>slow</color>. Hitting an enemy grants <color=#6fc075>Attack Speed</color> and <color=#6fc075>Critical Rate</color>.

646.name: Death Dealer
646.desc:
<color=#6fc075>Jumps</color> to the target, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color>.
If the target is defeated within a certain time, the skill's cooldown will be <color=#ffce49>reset</color>.

521.name: Moon's Farewell
521.desc: Spends moon crystals to use skills. When all moon crystals have been spent, her Skill 1 and Skill 2 will enter their cooldowns, and her next Basic Attack is <color=#6fc075>enhanced</color>, dealing extra <color=#db70d0>damage</color>. Skill 1 and Skill 2 apply a <color=#50c1eb>Mark</color> on hit. Hitting marked targets again triggers additional effects.

521.name: Crescent Wave
521.desc: Unleashes a beam of moonlight, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> and inflicting <color=#50c1eb>slow</color>. Deals extra <color=#d9d9d9>damage</color> if a <color=#50c1eb>mark</color> is triggered.

521.name: Wayward Rays
521.desc: Releases orbs to deal <color=#db70d0>damage</color> while gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color> and <color=#6fc075>increased Movement Speed</color>. If <color=#50c1eb>marks</color> are triggered, <color=#db70d0>damages</color> and <color=#50c1eb>stuns</color> targets.

521.name: Moonscape Mirage
521.desc: Links to a hero, gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color>. After a short delay, enters a <color=#ffce49>mirage</color> with the target, where her <color=#6fc075>cooldowns are shorter.</color>

523.name: Maiden's Trick
523.desc: The farther away the enemy is, the <color=#6bc872>more damage</color> skills deal.

523.name: Silk Imprint
523.desc: Throws her artifact, <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies and pulling them toward it. Can be used again to <color=#2bc6ff>pull</color> the enemy in the target direction.

523.name: Silky Beauty
523.desc: Releases an energy orb that continuously deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> to enemies within range for a short time, and then explodes to deal additional <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. Enemies are <color=#2bc6ff>slowed</color> the first time the orb hits them.

523.name: Sole Focus
523.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Resets</color> Skill 2's cooldown and <color=#6bc872>enhances</color> herself.
While enhanced, gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> and reduces Skill 2's <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> by half. Skill 1 can pull the enemy twice.

524.name: Fiery Temper
524.desc:
Cooldown is reduced when Attack Speed is increased.
<color=#6bc872>Gains</color> Anger when Basic Attack and Skill 1 hit targets. At max Anger, becomes Excited, <color=#6bc872>enhancing</color> all skills. While Excited, surplus Anger <color=#6bc872>restores</color> Health.

524.name: Awesome Barrage
524.desc:
Uses the Apocalyptor to strafe continuously and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
<color=#ffc834>Excited:</color> Bullets have a <color=#6bc872>piercing</color> effect, dealing half damage to subsequent enemies.

524.name: Heavy Shot
524.desc:
Shoots a heavy round in the target direction, inflicting <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slow</color>. Upon hitting an obstacle or reaching its max range, it will split into splinters that deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
<color=#ffc834>Excited:</color> Increases the number of splinters.

524.name: Missile Mayhem
524.desc:
Scans the vicinity and fires missiles at enemies within range who are attacked by teammates, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
<color=#ffc834>Excited:</color> Reduces interval between missiles.

528.name: Hunter
528.desc: Basic Attacks and skills deal extra <color=#ffffff>true damage</color> to targets with low Health.

528.name: Wavebreaker
528.desc:
Becomes <color=#ffc834>submerged</color> and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>. Use this skill again to <color=#6bc872>dash</color> and deal <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.
Can remain submerged indefinitely in the river. Gains extra <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color> when an enemy hero with low Health is nearby.

528.name: Space Split
528.desc:
<color=#ff6600>Damages</color> nearby enemies while gaining <color=#6bc872>marks</color> and <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health.
Basic Attacks consume marks to gain a <color=#6bc872>dash</color> and <color=#6bc872>Health recovery</color> effect.
Submerged: Skill 2 has an extra <color=#6bc872>dash</color> effect.

528.name: Death From Below
528.desc:
Throws a dagger in the target direction, then <color=#6bc872>dashes</color> to the dagger after a short delay, <color=#2bc6ff>dragging</color> enemies in his path to the dagger and dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to them.
Submerged: Cancels the cast point animation and skill delay.

531.name: Lethal Reflections
531.desc: Jing and her image apply 2 different types of marks on enemies when they deal damage. If an enemy has both types of mark at the same time, they take <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and the <color=#ffc834>cooldowns</color> of Skill 1 and Skill 2 are reset.

531.name: Reflective Assault
531.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward, <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> enemies in her path and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> them while enhancing her next Basic Attack.
<color=#ffc834>If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, one will be created to fight alongside her.</color>

531.name: Shattered Illusions
531.desc:
Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to nearby enemies while <color=#6bc872>recovering Health</color> and gaining <color=#6bc872>increased Movement Speed</color>.
<color=#ffc834>If no mirror image is present on the battlefield, then one will be created to fight alongside her.</color>

531.name: Dimensional Shift
531.desc: Switch locations with her mirror image. Stocks up to 4 charges.

531.name: Mirror Domain
531.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward, pulling enemies to the center of her magic circle and immobilizing them there. She gains <color=#ffc834>damage reduction</color> while inside the circle, and <color=#6bc872>recovers Health</color> when she swaps locations.

536.name: SPLASH GRADATION
536.desc:
After any skill hits an enemy, her next different skill used will be <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> to a follow-up skill.
Additionally, she gains 1 stack of <color=#6bc872>mark</color>, for up to 5 stacks. Consuming 3 stacks will <color=#6bc872>enhance</color> her next Basic Attack.

536.name: TRI-SLASH
536.desc: Initial Skill: After a short delay, releases TRI-SLASH in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>dealing damage</color> to enemies and <color=#6bc872>increasing her Movement Speed</color>.

536.name: SPLASH FOUNT
536.desc: Initial Skill: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> in the target direction, while <color=#ff6600>striking</color> several times. <color=#6bc872>Recovers</color> Health each time damage is dealt.

536.name: POWER GRADATION
536.desc: Initial Skill: Carves a seven-pointed star around her, <color=#ff6600>dealing damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> nearby enemies. Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> and <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> while the skill is active.

537.name: Wish of the Living
537.desc: Devara's Basic Attacks grant Energy. Becomes <color=#6fc075>enhanced</color> and gains another basic skill chance upon reaching the limit.

537.name: Thunderblaze
537.desc: <color=#6fc075>Dashes</color> forward, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> to enemies in his path while gaining a <color=#6fc075>shield</color>.

537.name: Divine Judgment
537.desc: <color=#50c1eb>Knocks back</color> and <color=#db70d0>damages</color> enemies in front of him.

537.name: Millennium Echo
537.desc: Gains <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color> and a <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed boost</color>. Upon landing, <color=#6fc075>enhances</color> Basic Attack. Basic Attacks grant Energy.

538.name: Spear Will - Sweeping Fire
538.desc: Gains an <color=#6fc075>enhanced</color> Basic Attack after using skills. Using the enhanced Basic Attack reduces the <color=#6fc075>cooldowns</color> of Skill 1 and Skill 2.

538.name: Cloudchaser
538.desc: Gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> while charging, then <color=#6fc075>dashes</color> forward, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color> enemies.

538.name: Starburn
538.desc:
Dashes in the target direction, then returns to her original location, <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> and dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemies in her path. She gains <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color> and <color=#6fc075>damage reduction</color> while dashing.
Second Phase: Deals <color=#db70d0>damage</color> over time in the target location.
While Starburn is active, the second phase of the skill sweeps her surroundings, interrupting subsequent dashes, dealing area <color=#fa863a>damage</color>, and leaving a ring of fire behind for 0.2s.

542.name: Jade Carriage - View from Above
542.desc: Can jump onto and <color=#ffc834>walk</color> on natural walls. Basic Attack becomes ranged while on a wall.

542.name: Jade Chase - Returning Strike
542.desc: <color=#6bc872>Dashes</color>, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies in his path and <color=#2dc6ff>launching</color> them. Enhances his next 3 Basic Attacks. Enhanced Basic Attacks deal extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>restore Health</color>.

542.name: Hardened Jade Seal
542.desc: <color=#ff6600>Damages</color> and marks nearby enemies. Using the skill again unleashes 4 strikes of <color=#ff6600>damage</color>. The last strike will <color=#ffc834>defeat</color> marked enemies with low health. <color=#ffc834>Can use to jump down from walls.</color>

545.name: Rebellious Little Hawk
545.desc: Basic Attacks deal area damage and extra <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color>.

545.name: Upgraded Shell
545.desc: <color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> his next 3 Basic Attacks to deal extra <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> in a greater area.

545.name: Legendary Hero Debut
545.desc: Throws a smoke bomb, creating a cloud of smoke that grants <color=#ffc834>Stealth</color> to teammates within it, including himself. The bomb's explosion sends him <color=#ffc834>airborne</color>, and his Basic Attacks allow him to stay airborne longer.

545.name: Sunset Fireworks Show
545.desc: <color=#ffc834>Leaps into the air</color> and fires several shells, each shell dealing <color=#ff6600>physical damage</color> to the target in the area. Up to 1 enemy can take a shell for the target.

556.name: Child of the Sea
556.desc:
His lost Health is preserved in a temporary <color=#ffc834>Health buffer</color>. Dealing damage <color=#6bc872>converts</color> buffered Health into actual Health.
After a while, the buffered Health will begin to gradually diminish.
His Basic Attacks deal extra <color=#ff6600>damage</color>.

556.name: Wavewalking
556.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Leaps</color> into the air and slams down twice, <color=#ff6600>dealing damage</color> with each slam.
The second slam <color=#2dc6ff>launches</color> enemies.
Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> while using the skill.

556.name: Sea Anchor
556.desc:
Hurls an anchor in the target direction, <color=#ff6600>dealing damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>slowing</color> enemies.
If the anchor hits terrain, he will be dragged to the contact point, <color=#ff6600>dealing damage</color> and <color=#2dc6ff>knocking back</color> enemies.
His next Basic Attack will be <color=#6bc872>enhanced</color> with a <color=#6bc872>pulling</color> effect.

556.name: Ghost Ship
556.desc:
Builds temporary <color=#ffc834>terrain</color> along the outer edge of a cone-shaped area, dealing <color=#ff6600>damage</color> to enemies within it.
Gains <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color> while using the skill.
He can use the skill again to make the temporary terrain disappear early.

172.name: Forge Inheritor
172.desc: Basic Attacks <color=#6fc075>restore Health</color> and switch her weapons and combat forms. When hitting enemies with Basic Attacks or skills, she gains <color=#6fc075>Attack Speed</color>.

172.name: Peak-Crushing Polearm
172.desc: Dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path and <color=#50c1eb>launching</color> them.

172.name: World-Splitting Spear
172.desc: Thrusts forward in the target direction, dealing damage, knocking enemies back, and <color=#6fc075>recovering Health</color>.

172.name: Return of the Armsmaster
172.desc: Enhances herself, gaining <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> and <color=#6fc075>Attack Speed</color>, and breaking the Fighting Spirit stack limit. Her Basic Attacks will also deal extra damage, and she will be able to use them while moving.

564.name: Slack Off a Lil Bit
564.desc: Using skills consumes Strength, which is <color=#6bc872>recovered</color> over time. When not moving, Strength and Health <color=#6bc872>recover</color> faster.

564.name: Whatever (I)
564.desc:
Runs in the target direction and pulls enemies in front, dealing <color=#ff6600>area damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>slowing</color> them.
1-1 Combo: Deals <color=#ff6600>area damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>launches</color> enemies.
1-2 Combo: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health.

564.name: Whatever (II)
564.desc:
Skill 2: <color=#6bc872>Flips</color> forward, gains <color=#ffc834>immunity</color> and <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color>, and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health.
2-1 Combo: Blinks behind the enemy, <color=#2bc6ff>knocking them back</color> and <color=#ff6600>damaging</color> them.
2-2 Combo: Deals <color=#ff6600>damage</color> before leaping back, gaining <color=#ffc834>immunity</color> and <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color>, and <color=#6bc872>recovering</color> Health.

564.name: Get Serious
564.desc: <color=#ff6600>Damages</color> nearby enemies and <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Punch Strength and Kick Strength. For 10s, increases max Strength and gains <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

631.name: Shuffle
631.desc: After leaving combat or touching a bouquet, enhances the next Basic Attack to include a dash and deal extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color>. If the attack hits a hero, <color=#6fc075>recovers</color> Health. He can dash again after the initial dash.

631.name: Blossom
631.desc: Tosses a bouquet, <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> and <color=#50c1eb>stunning</color> the first enemy hit, then scatters more bouquets. Touching a bouquet enhances his Basic Attack and refreshes the cooldown of Triple Threat.

631.name: Triple Threat
631.desc: Attacks the target 3 times, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color>. Each hit deals extra <color=#d9d9d9>true damage</color> and reduces the cooldown of Blossom. He can dash after each hit.

631.name: Gentlemen's Duel
631.desc: Dashes forward and marks the first target, increasing their <color=#50c1eb>damage taken</color>, then scatters bouquets. While the skill is active, recovers twice as much Health and gains <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color>. He can dash again after the initial dash.

635.name: Eternal
635.desc: Skill 2 or Ultimate hits also damage units near the target.

635.name: Here's What I Think
635.desc: Lorion moves his orb around to damage units in its path.

635.name: Starry Night
635.desc: After a short delay, the orb damages and <color=#ff7f90>levitates</color> nearby enemies.

159.name: Mermaid's Gift
159.desc:
Transforms into a mermaid while in water, reducing slow effects, <color=#6bc872>recovering Health and Mana</color> over time, and dealing area damage with Basic Attacks. 
Her Recovery skill changes to let her form a covenant with a teammate. Her Ultimate prioritizes resetting this teammate's skill cooldowns.

159.name: Ode
159.desc: Unleashes soundwaves that <color=#f264ff>deal damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>inflict slow</color>. When in water, the last soundwave <color=#2bc6ff>knocks back</color> enemies.

159.name: Wavemaker
159.desc: Creates a <color=#ffc834>pool</color> in the target direction, <color=#6bc872>restoring Health and Mana</color> to herself and teammates within. The pool disappears after she leaves it.

159.name: Celestial Melody
159.desc: <color=#ffc834>Resets</color> the longest current skill cooldown of a teammate within range, transferring the cooldown to herself. Prioritizes covenant teammates.

563.name: Fate's Guidance
563.desc: Basic Attack <color=#f264ff>damage</color> differs depending on whether he is in melee or ranged mode. Skills and melee Basic Attacks place <color=#2bc6ff>marks</color> on enemies.

563.name: Scepter of Fate
563.desc:
Attacks in the target direction. If the target has a mark, skill <color=#6bc872>cooldown</color> is reduced.
Ranged: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and an extra attack to marked targets.
Melee: Deals <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and inflicts <color=#2bc6ff>slow</color>. <color=#6bc872>Recovers Health</color> upon hitting marked targets.

563.name: Leap of Fate
563.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Dashes</color> forward and <color=#ffc834>switches</color> attack mode.
Enters melee mode if enemy heroes are nearby, <color=#6bc872>increasing</color> Physical and Magical Defense and <color=#6bc872>restoring</color> Health; otherwise, enters ranged mode, leaving a memory and gaining <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.

563.name: Fate Rewind
563.desc:
Gains <color=#6bc872>damage reduction</color> and <color=#ffc834>crowd control immunity</color>, <color=#6bc872>recovers</color> Health based on his current Health, and cannot move. Deals <color=#f264ff>magical damage</color> and <color=#ffc834>travels back</color> to where he was.
If there is an allied tower within range, it <color=#ffc834>returns</color> to its state from 1.5s ago.

547.name: Serpent's Envoy
547.desc: Luara's Basic Attacks unleash the serpent blade at the enemy and deal damage. Each skill use increases her Attack Speed.

547.name: Deadly Fang
547.desc: Activates a serpent blade and <color=#6fc075>gains Movement Speed</color>. She can quickly <color=#ffce49>scale walls</color> should she run into them during this period.

547.name: Furtive Attack
547.desc:
Summons the Fire Serpent at the target location, which then moves toward her, <color=#db70d0>damaging</color>, <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color>, and slightly <color=#50c1eb>pulling back</color> enemies in its path.
If serpent blades are active, it deals extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemies. If not, this skill's cooldown is returned.

547.name: Blazing Glare
547.desc:
Releases the Fire Serpent in the target direction, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> and <color=#ffce49>blinding</color> enemies in its path, and gains a serpent blade while enhancing herself.
While enhanced, damaging enemies will accumulate Energy. At full Energy, deals <color=#db70d0>area damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>launches</color> enemies.

519.name: Hidden Dragon
519.desc:
The Dragon Souls from his last 2 skill uses grant effects to his Basic Attacks, which <color=#fa863a>damages</color> one extra enemy.
<color=#ffce49>He gains marks when using skills, enhancing his next Basic Attack.</color>
<color=#4f6f95>When a target is attacked by more than 1 Dragon Soul, subsequent hits deal only 1% damage. When switching between Dragon Souls, souls of the same element are prioritized.</color>

519.name: Flaming Palm
519.desc:
Unleashes sword energy, dealing <color=#fa863a>physical damage</color> and <color=#d9d9d9>true damage</color> to enemies within range.
Subsequent Basic Attacks deal extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color>.

519.name: Downpour
519.desc:
Unleashes sword energy, dealing <color=#fa863a>physical damage</color> to enemies within range and recovering <color=#6fc075>Health</color> on hit.
Subsequent Basic Attacks restore <color=#6fc075>Health</color> and <color=#6fc075>Mana</color>.

519.name: Riding the Wind
519.desc:
Unleashes sword energy, immediately gaining <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> while <color=#fa863a>damaging</color> and <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> enemies within range.
The <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> increase persists after the skill ends.

519.name: Infinite Vastness
519.desc:
Soars into the sky, then dives forward to <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slow</color> enemies in his path. Landing deals equal <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and applies <color=#50c1eb>Dread</color>.
<color=#ffce49>Enhances</color> himself, allowing his Basic Attacks to hit up to 2 more enemies.

577.name: Melodic Swing
577.desc:
<color=#6bc872>Enhances</color> her next Basic Attack periodically to swing toward the enemy, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#2bc6ff>knocking them back</color>, then <color=#6bc872>jumping back</color>.
When any hero receives <color=#ffc834>Blessing of Fate</color> or <color=#ffc834>Bitter Reconciliation</color>, she earns <color=#ffc834>Gold</color> and reduces the preparation time of her enhanced Basic Attack.

577.name: Heartlink
577.desc:
Blesses a teammate and <color=#6bc872>restores</color> Health. When two blessed teammates come close, they <color=#6bc872>recover</color> Health and gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.
If she blesses an already blessed teammate, she will <color=#6bc872>dash</color> to them, and both <color=#6bc872>recover Health</color> and gain <color=#6bc872>Movement Speed</color>.
Can use this skill again within 5s.

577.name: Bitter Farewell
577.desc:
Marks an enemy, <color=#2bc6ff>exposes</color> them and deals continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color>. When two marked enemies come close, they stop taking damage.
If she uses the skill on a marked enemy, she will <color=#6bc872>dash</color> to them, <color=#2bc6ff>immobilizing</color> them and dealing continuous <color=#f264ff>damage</color>.
Can use this skill again within 5s.

577.name: Destined Encounter
577.desc: Commands a swarm of wisps to fly forward, blessing and granting Health <color=#6bc872>recovery</color> to teammates, while marking and <color=#f264ff>damaging</color> enemies.

582.name: Flow of the World
582.desc:
Can use Flow at the Base to enhance stats.
Spends Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals extra <color=#db70d0>damage</color>, which spreads to nearby enemies.

582.name: Convergence
582.desc:
Channels the Flow, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> to nearby enemies and <color=#50c1eb>knocking them back</color>. Also <color=#6fc075>recovers Health</color>, gains 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of other skills.
<color=#4f6f95>Nearby teammates and minions increase Health recovery and Flow stacks.</color>

582.name: Starflow Cascade
582.desc:
Throws an orb in the target direction, dealing <color=#f264ff>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slowing</color> the target, then dealing <color=#f264ff>damage over time</color>.
Repeated uses increase the range and stun the enemy.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use an additional Starflow Cascade.</color>

582.name: Arcane Arts
582.desc:
Continuously channels a beam to deal <color=#db70d0>damage over time</color> to chained enemies.
When the beam is formed, it deals extra <color=#db70d0>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>slows</color> enemies.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to cast an additional Arcane Arts. Other skills can be used during this skill.</color>

583.name: Flow of the World
583.desc:
Can use Flow at the Base to enhance stats.
Spends Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals <color=#db70d0>damage</color>.

583.name: Convergence
583.desc:
Channels the Flow, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to nearby enemies and <color=#50c1eb>knocking them back</color>. Also <color=#6fc075>recovers Health</color>, gains 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of other skills.
<color=#4f6f95>Nearby teammates and minions provide extra recovery and Flow.</color>

583.name: Claw Flurry
583.desc:
Dashes in the target direction to deal <color=#fa863a>damage</color>, then repeatedly phases through enemies
to deal <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#6fc075>recover Health</color>.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to use an extra Claw Flurry.</color>

583.name: Mortal Talons
583.desc:
Dashes to the target location and gains <color=#ffce49>crowd control immunity</color>, dealing <color=#fa863a>damage</color> to enemies in their path. At the destination, deals extra <color=#fa863a>damage</color> and <color=#50c1eb>knocks back</color> enemies.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to use an extra Mortal Talons.</color>

585.name: Flow of the World
585.desc:
Can use Flow at the Base to enhance stats.
Spends Flow to perform an enhanced Basic Attack that deals <color=#db70d0>damage</color>, then ricochets to deal <color=#db70d0>damage</color> or restore <color=#6fc075>Health</color>.

585.name: Convergence
585.desc:
Channels the Flow, dealing <color=#db70d0>damage</color> to nearby enemies and <color=#50c1eb>knocking them back</color>. Also <color=#6fc075>recovers Health</color>, gains 5 stacks of Flow, and reduces the cooldown of other skills.
<color=#4f6f95>Nearby teammates and minions increase Health recovery and Flow stacks.</color>

585.name: Protection Melody
585.desc:
Raises a platform, <color=#50c1eb>knocking back</color> nearby enemies. Teammates on the platform gain increased <color=#6fc075>vision, attack, and skill range</color> and a <color=#6fc075>shared shield</color>.
Using the skill again while on the platform refreshes its duration and expands it, while further boosting the <color=#6fc075>attack and skill range</color> and <color=#6fc075>shield</color> effects. Dashes when leaving the platform.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 4 stacks of Flow to gain an extra Protection Melody use as well as increased attack and skill range while on the platform.</color>

585.name: Lingering Melody
585.desc:
Gains <color=#6fc075>Movement Speed</color> and unleashes sound waves in the target direction that <color=#6fc075>restore their Health</color> when they hit. Hitting an enemy deals <color=#db70d0>damage</color>, hitting an ally restores <color=#6fc075>Health</color>, and hitting a wall causes the attack to ricochet and create a new sound wave.
<color=#4f6f95>Can spend 5 stacks of Flow to use this skill again.</color>
